description: This file defines a class 'Table' with methods for manipulating HTML tables, including adding/removing rows and columns, deleting tables, and handling cell attributes. It also includes a 'TableResultAction' class for calculating actions on table cells, especially considering cell spans.

classes.name: Table
classes.description: A class providing methods to manipulate HTML tables, including adding/removing rows and columns, deleting tables, and navigating cells.

methods.name: tab
methods.description: Handles tab key navigation within table cells.

methods.name: addRow
methods.description: Adds a new row either at the top or bottom of the current table.

methods.name: addCol
methods.description: Adds a new column either to the left or right of the current cell.

methods.name: recoverAttributes
methods.description: Copies attributes from a table cell element, excluding 'id'.

methods.name: deleteRow
methods.description: Deletes the row containing the specified cell, adjusting rowspan as needed.

methods.name: deleteCol
methods.description: Deletes the column containing the specified cell, adjusting colspan as needed.

methods.name: createTable
methods.description: Creates an empty HTML table with specified rows and columns.

methods.name: deleteTable
methods.description: Removes the entire table containing the specified cell.
